data.what_it_does: PanoramaViewer displays a 360° image and lets users rotate it with touch or device sensors. It supports Android, iOS, and web (without sensors).
use_when: Need an interactive 360° image viewer in a Flutter app.
Want to use device motion to control the view on mobile.
Building a virtual tour or product showcase with panoramic images.
avoid_when: Using an older Flutter SDK (<3.47) or Dart (<3.13).
Requiring full sensor support on web or older Android/Kotlin setups.
strengths: Simple API, no extra code generation.
Supports device sensors for natural interaction.
Updated to latest Flutter and Dart versions.
weaknesses: Requires recent Flutter/Dart and specific Android/Kotlin setup.
No built-in support for custom hotspots or overlays.
data.setup_notes: Upgrade to Flutter 3.47+ and Dart 3.13+. Android needs AGP 9, Kotlin 2.4.20+, Gradle 9.3.1, Java/Kotlin 17. iOS uses Swift Package Manager and requires iOS 13+. Add dchs_motion_sensors ^3.0.0 as dependency.
